mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.id,d.record_date,d.mood_code,d.mood_score,d.activity_content,d.feeling_content,d.keyword_text,d.status,d.is_favorite='1' favorite,IF(d.privacy_type='1','PUBLIC','PRIVATE') privacy_type,d.server_version,d.create_time,d.update_time FROM diary_record d LEFT JOIN diary_tag_relation r ON r.diary_id=d.id LEFT JOIN diary_tag t ON t.id=r.tag_id WHERE d.user_id=#{userId} AND d.status<>'2' AND d.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND (#{keyword}='' OR d.activity_content LIKE #{pattern} OR d.feeling_content LIKE #{pattern} OR d.keyword_text LIKE #{pattern}) AND (#{mood}='' OR d.mood_code=#{mood}) AND (#{tag}='' OR t.tag_name=#{tag}) ORDER BY d.record_date DESC

SELECT d.id,d.user_id author_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),'五行朋友') author_name,u.avatar_url,d.record_date,d.mood_code,d.mood_score,d.activity_content,d.feeling_content,'PUBLIC' privacy_type,d.user_id=#{viewerId} mine,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_comment c WHERE c.diary_id=d.id AND c.status='0') comment_count,d.create_time,d.update_time FROM diary_record d JOIN app_user u ON u.id=d.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE d.status='1' AND d.privacy_type='1' ORDER BY d.create_time DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
